Solution 2: Includes rows y=4 and y=-4, which are on the boundary; uses 9 rows instead of 7. Gets 81. Incorrect.

Solution 3: Uses a flawed inclusion–exclusion (larger rectangle has 143 points, but subtracts the wrong set). Gets 109. Incorrect.

None match the correct answer of 63.
